notes.zh-CN: 新增引导模式（Steer Mode）：在设置中开启后，回合进行中发送消息会停下当前回合，这条消息立即发进同一个会话生效；关闭时保持排队行为，等回合结束后自动发送。本次提供 macOS universal 安装包。Windows x64/ARM64 未构建：GitHub Actions 因账号付款或额度限制无法启动。
notes.en: New Steer Mode: when enabled in Settings, sending while a turn is running stops that turn and applies your message immediately in the same session; when off, messages are queued until the turn ends. Includes the macOS universal installer. Windows x64/ARM64 installers were not built because GitHub Actions is blocked by account payment or spending limits.
